verdict.rationale: Obsidian docs describe community plugins for extending functionality (obsidian-docs-7, obsidian-docs-31), with a security model (Restricted Mode) governing third-party code (obsidian-docs-27), and community evidence lists specific popular community plugins users actually installed (Ink, Self-Hosted LiveSync, Copilot, Whisper, ReadItLater, Relay, Dataview-replacement discussions) confirming a real, actively used catalog (obsidian-comm-6, obsidian-comm-9, obsidian-comm-12). Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshot of the in-app community plugin browser/catalog UI and store size/count, and independent verification of catalog scale beyond anecdotal plugin mentions.
